meta.paper: Yang et al., Dangers Behind Access Control (CCS '25)

edges.name: clusterrolebinding-grants-all
edges.title: create/update/patch ClusterRoleBinding → `*` on `*` (all verbs, all resources)

edges.name: csr-approval-issues-cert
edges.title: update/patch/get CertificateSigningRequest/approval → update/patch/get CertificateSigningRequest
edges.status_reason: update certificatesigningrequests/approval ALONE cannot approve a CSR: the apiserver also authorizes "approve" on signers/<signerName>, so approval was Forbidden ("not permitted to approve requests with signerName kubernetes.io/kube-apiserver-client"). The signer controller IS active (granting approve signers/<signerName> makes the identical approval succeed and status.certificate populate); the single-permission transition is therefore not operationally reproducible -- operational p is "update .../approval AND approve signers/<signerName>".

edges.name: apiservice-reaches-services
edges.title: create APIService → get/watch Service
edges.status_reason: the aggregator's get/watch of the backing Service requires a real aggregated/extension apiserver behind the APIService (vanilla single-node kind has none; an ordinary Service is not an apiserver and the APIService goes Available=False/FailedDiscoveryCheck), and the aggregator's read runs with its own credentials inside the apiserver with no status/audit surface here that attributes a specific get/watch to the registered APIService -- unprovable without standing up an extension apiserver and mutating shared cluster state.

edges.name: storageclass-create-creates-pv
edges.title: create StorageClass → create PersistentVolume
edges.status_reason: a StorageClass alone creates no PV; dynamic provisioning is provisioner-mediated and demand-driven (needs a PVC referencing the class, plus a consuming Pod under WaitForFirstConsumer, the mode of this cluster's default rancher.io/local-path class). create-storageclass ALONE never yields a PersistentVolume.
